description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for git rebase functionality, including setup, various rebase scenarios, and handling of edge cases.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and optional file contents.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that should succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or outputs.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Allows a command's failure without failing the test.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches output for a specific pattern.
